title: Transcript
description: One transcript file: one test id (design 5).

id.description: The test id. It equals the file name without `.json`, and it is in the ledger.

contract.description: The ledger prefix that owns the id.

clause.description: The clause row id, for example `EN-8`.

setup.description: Limits and a named fixture. Its shape belongs to the suite.

steps.description: The ordered script. Its step kinds belong to the suite, except the order constructs of the engine.

seeds.description: Pinned seeds. Absent means every seed of the run.

kind.description: `withdrawn` marks a transcript with no steps.

fake.description: `structural` marks a transcript that runs in full only against a real implementation. It needs a `ruling`.

ruling.description: The steward ruling that makes the transcript structural against a fake, for example `R-5`.

Contract.description: The ledger prefix that owns a test id (design section 2).

Requires.description: What a subject must offer for a transcript to apply (design 5.1).

features.description: Feature names that the subject must advertise. A subject without one gives `not_applicable`.

controls.description: Test controls that the transcript uses. A subject without one gives `unsupported_control`.

TranscriptKind.description: A transcript that has no steps by design (design section 2, withdrawn ids).

FakeMode.description: How a subject's fake treats a transcript (design 5.1, `fake`).

oneOf.description:
The subject's fake does not model this behavior by steward ruling (`ruling`). Against the fake the runner checks the stimuli
only (`structural`). Against a real implementation the transcript runs in full.
